assessmentPlan: Fixed 32 color-reversed development pairs, four 8-pair JVM blocks; complete all games unless operational failure. Does filtering reduced-unverified quiet maluses add value when completed hints and retained EFFORT history are both present? Reverse ablation of the nominal-learning filter. Both sides are experimental configurations of the same frozen candidate binary. Same development openings as prior screens; repeated/correlated comparisons and selection uncertainty are explicit. Descriptive pair estimates/intervals only; no component promotion or independent Elo prerequisite. No outcome stopping, post-hoc extension or selective replay. Select a complete candidate from combined semantic, cost and clock evidence before any fresh independent confirmation.
forecast: About 25-45 minutes each at 85-155 games/hour; bounded 15-minute blocks, one active Search worker/game, BelowNormal engine process priority; stop-before admission gate. Not equal CPU; process-cost/GC and complete request accounting audited.
baselineProvenance: Experimental ablation reference, not the accepted champion: policy 5 on the same frozen clock-v1-candidate installation as candidate policy 7. Primary champion comparisons remain separately recorded.
rationale: Champion-relative development estimates are +83 Elo for hints and +60 for all features, with broad correlated uncertainty. Direct retained-history and reverse-filter contrasts can separate conditional contribution from whole-candidate success; a lower point estimate alone does not establish harm.
